text:
You need reliable help handling flexible office and support tasks while keeping appointments, research, data entry, and other clerical work organized and accurate.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience working with SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m comfortable supporting day-to-day administrative work that depends on detail, structure, and clear communication, and I can adapt quickly to the kind of varied responsibilities described in your post.

In a past project for Marlowe Furniture, I built a Sales KPI dashboard using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. The work replaced 14 separate Excel sales reports with one Power BI report built on a star-schema model. As a result, monthly close reporting moved from 3 days to 4 hours. That project required careful data organization, strong Excel work, and dependable analysis to make reporting faster and easier to use.

For this role, I would bring the same attention to accuracy and follow-through to tasks like scheduling appointments, researching information, handling data entry, and supporting general office operations. I’m also comfortable working in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Word, and I can help keep information clean, organized, and easy to review. If there are recurring reports, tracking sheets, or internal data updates, I can help maintain those as well.

I understand this position is capped at 25 hours per week and is very flexible, which makes it a good fit for consistent support across a range of administrative needs. I’m dependable, responsive, and used to working with data and office materials that need to be handled carefully.

I’d be glad to attach my resume and discuss how I can support your team.
